family_reports.body: I now have no trust in the family court system. I fear every time I communicate with the other party that it will be used against me and twisted. I feel as though I’m one step away from being taken back into that nightmare every day over false allegations.

Instead of protecting my children, this system has enabled disruption, ignored critical concerns, and created outcomes that have damaged our family’s stability, trust, and long-term well-being. The family court system has fractured my family across three cases, replacing stability with conflict and allowing inconsistent decisions and broken processes to erode my children’s relationships, security, and trust.
I have lost my children, filed bankruptcy, and lost my career due to ongoing litigation rooted in coercive control and manipulation.

My children’s childhood was stolen from them. They were taken on false allegations over 3 years. Which were all determined unsubstantiated- they still have not returned home. They have been withheld court ordered therapy treatment for 3 years with no enforcement that could help them heal
